question: What analogy explains how all knowledges and actions converge in the great Lord?
premises: All drops of water come to rest in the great ocean.
All knowledges and actions are diverse in form.
The great Lord is the ocean of consciousness.
inference: Just as all water drops rest in the ocean, all knowledges and actions ultimately rest in the great Lord, the ocean of consciousness.
plain_english: Just as all drops of water come to rest in the great ocean, so all knowledges and actions come to rest in the great Lord, the ocean of consciousness.
